prompts.prompt: In Flask, which single-letter global object provides request-scoped scratch space for stashing data during one request, distinct from current_app? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/flask/SKILL.md - g | App context (per-request) | Request-scoped scratch space

prompts.prompt: What is the minimum Python version required to run Flask 3.1? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/flask/SKILL.md - Flask 3.1 runs on Python 3.10+ and supports async views via asgiref.

prompts.prompt: When you write an async view in Flask, does it actually run on a true asyncio event loop, or does Flask execute it somewhere else under the hood? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/flask/SKILL.md - Async views run in a thread pool, not on an event loop. Limitations: one request per thread, no true concurrency.
